items.reason: Describes the same ownership-check bypass when a missing Integration row causes the pipeline to advance without verifying the installer.
Describes the same unguarded sender metadata lookup that raises KeyError when sender is absent.
Concerns timing leakage from the state comparison. Making the comparison constant-time would not fix #03's use of a static, predictable state instead of a per-attempt nonce.
Describes the same loss of translation extraction caused by calling gettext on error_short while passing unmarked literals.
Describes the same KeyError and installation-flow 500 caused by directly indexing missing sender metadata.
Describes the same incorrect OAuth state that makes the installation-not-found test stop before reaching the installation lookup.
Describes the same unguarded sender metadata lookup and resulting KeyError for integrations without sender metadata.
Describes the same unhandled failures in the OAuth token exchange and user-info fetch that produce server errors instead of the installation error page.
